title: redshift-extension
description: Workflow epic: create logic where i can directly query aws redshift from duckdb. v1 = redshift_scan() table function backed by connectorx; spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-05-redshift-extension-design.md; plan docs/superpowers/plans/2026-05-05-redshift-extension-plan.md

value: Workflow 'redshift-extension': core approach — Rust DuckDB extension using connectorx Rust API to expose redshift_scan() table function. v1 = table function only (ATTACH deferred). Auth = DuckDB Secret OR env vars (REDSHIFT_HOST/PORT/USER/PASSWORD/DATABASE/SSLMODE), no user-supplied DSN. TLS default sslmode=require. Optional partitioned parallel reads via partition_on/partition_num (integer-only, max 64). Postgres-protocol path; Vec-materialized result via connectorx 0.4 ArrowDestination, walked into DuckDB. Tests: unit + Postgres-via-testcontainers in CI + gated real-Redshift suite for pre-release. Three de-risk spikes: arrow/arrow2 + Dispatcher API (Task 1), DuckDB Rust extension framework + set_arrow type matrix (Task 2), DuckDB Secrets API (Task 2.5). FFI panic boundary mandatory. DUCKDB version derived from Cargo.toml at build time. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-05-redshift-extension-design.md, Plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-05-05-redshift-extension-plan.md.

Workflow 'redshift-extension': explicitly out of scope for v1 — ATTACH 'redshift://...' catalog integration (deferred to v2 with reuse of config/pipeline modules); IAM-based credentials (GetClusterCredentials); auto-detected partition column; UNLOAD/S3 fast path; DuckDB Community Extensions submission; signed binaries; statement_timeout_ms named arg (incompatible with partition wrapping); cooperative cancellation; connection pooling; writes/DML to Redshift.
